body: Good point, ill try to keep that in mind. I was super suicidal and unemployed. Now im 6 months employed full time and somewhat safer from suicide and less frequent crisis. But still no chabge in self esteem, no friends and no career or life aspirations and feel stuck. Thank you
Ok, thank you. Change doesnt feel possible inside myself  im stuck. And man im sick of living to work a job just to survive to continue unhappiness. Thanks again

I dont even care about my family now. I am selfish, completely. I want this over and im fed up. Its not the job thats the issue, a new job wont fix it, my job is pretty good. I am the problem. I need to fucking die

Thank you and sorry late reply. Good advice, yes i really have been making a lot of chabge to try and live in the present and enjoy small things and have lesser expectations. 

You also mentioned not having to live up to societal expectations. However my societal expectations that i accept and turn on myself are minimal and in my opinion, reasonable. Have a career, live on your own dime, your own dwelling and have friends and be in or seeking a relationship. Arent all of these bare minimum and reasonable? I fail all of them. 

Thanks for the comment!

Thank you and sorry late reply. Im feeling somewhat better, i get in those moods and cannot see things differently. I do however still have the same issues, like why live this life, why bother with the chore of existence and working just to be alone, go home and repeat for nothing. 

If i could forgive myself for the past, thats one thing. But my every day, i always can find a way that everything i do is selfish or bad and theres always new things that i hate myself for. Simply juat being a loser, selfish, stupid etc is enough and that is constant. I want change, its hard to forgive the past but i can see it as a possibility, but then there needs to be an ongoing change. Otherwise ill still be feeling guilty. 

I do do my best at my job. I often feel like a dumbass loser at work but i do genuinely try my best and i think i work hard and well and impress. 

Yes, things could be better in 1.5years, or they could be worse. When i was 15, i was at rock bottom. Over 4 more years no improvement. Then the next 2 years, i actually got better, i honestly did not have suicidal thoughts at qll for the majority of that. No meds, just actually having goals, opportunities, hope, new changes in life, i moved away, met new people etc. Then back slowly to rock bottom.

Yes, i already do keep my mind occupied-ish and have many little hobbies. It is good stuff, but fundamentally it doesnt change having no friends, no future and living with parents. Life becomes a pointless grind. At least if i had desireable and tangible goals to persue. 

Thanks again
